name: rpg-alter
description: RPG textual de sobrevivência no Centro de Pesquisa Farmacêutica Lázaro

scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');function walk(d){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){const p=path.join(d,f);if(fs.statSync(p).isDirectory())walk(p);else if(p.endsWith('.js'))require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',p]);}}walk('.');console.log('Sintaxe JavaScript validada.');"
